goal: Catch Guix build breakages and codesigning manifest errors continuously in CI
Prevent release-blocking surprises that maintainers currently discover only late in the cycle
reviewability: Ready for review after earlier commits were restructured and CI passed
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (fanquake, sedited)
Concern over duplicate caching was resolved by dropping the overlapping commit (hebasto)
Open question remains on relying on third-party substitute servers

categories.name: build
why: P2 because continuous verification of Guix environments protects against release-time regressions
Missing imports and broken signing dependencies are caught before release signing begins
